description: List the project's trails — the unit of shipping (an outcome with its items, milestones, pull requests and release tools; each row carries its lead, start and target dates, health and progress). LIST BEFORE YOU CREATE: check no trail already ships this. PAGING: `limit` (1–200) is REQUIRED; pass the previous `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page. FILTERS (optional, ANDed, applied in SQL): `scope` = mine | reviewing | ready | releasing | shipped | closed | all (default all); `phase` = planning | building | reviewing | ready | releasing | shipped | closed; `type` = feature | bug | task; `health` = on_track | at_risk | off_track; `owner` = a person or agent (the lead); `q` = substring of title or body. SORT (optional): `sort` = number | title | phase | priority | owner | health | progress | target | changes | findings | items | released | updated | created, `-` prefixed for descending (default `-updated`). ATTRIBUTION: `mergedSince` (ISO-8601) with `touches` (a file path or a resource key) lists the trails that merged in a window and changed a path or link a resource — the candidates for an error or alert that started after a release.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in the previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

f.description: The table's filter conditions: a JSON array of `{ "f", "o", "v" }` objects, ANDed. See the operation description for the fields.

health.description: A trail's effective health — the one a person set, or else the derived one. Derived, first match wins: `off_track` when the target date has passed and the trail has not shipped, or a rollout is `fixing` after a pull-back; `at_risk` when the target is at most 7 days away and progress is under 75 %, or a high finding or a high or critical item on the trail is open; otherwise `on_track`. A list row carries the snapshot; the detail read recomputes it.

limit.description: Page size (1–200). A page shorter than `limit` is the last one.

mergedSince.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Narrow to trails with a change merged at or after it.

owner.description: Narrow to trails owned by one person OR one agent — a `users.id`, email or display name, or a connector id, display name or handle. Case-insensitive exact match.

phase.description: Where a trail is, derived from its changes and its release resources — `planning` (no change and no open run), `building` (no change yet, a run is working), `reviewing` (a change is open and not every open change can merge), `ready` (every open change can merge), `releasing` (merged, and a flag, experiment or other release resource has not settled), `shipped` (merged and every release resource settled), `closed` (closed with nothing merged). The detail read recomputes it live; the list reads a snapshot.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring filter across the trail's title and body.

scope.description: A dashboard tab: `mine` (owned by the caller), `reviewing`, `ready`, `releasing`, `shipped`, `closed`, or `all` (the default, no narrowing).

sort.description: A column id, `-` prefixed for descending (`-updated`). An unknown column is a `400`.

touches.description: A file path (or path prefix) a merged change changed, or a resource key the trail links. Narrow to trails that touch it.

type.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

view.description: `table` answers the dashboard table read (`f`, `sort`, `cursor`, `limit`, `section_counts`, `grouped`). Omitted, `f` and `sort` are still honoured and the envelope is `{ data, next_cursor }`.

name: trails_list
